I've answered Tobias in a thread reply in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

The answer comes from this channel's history, which Tobias can see because he's a member. On 2025-09-03, Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at the Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. At 18:43 she said the outage was resolved and Southgate had cleared the backlog.

I told him the channel doesn't give a street address for the depot. I also couldn't find any account files for Tansley in the shared files, so I can't say more about where the site is.
